probe_contract.description: Copy-only finite staged-LDGSTS operand stream. A 128-thread CTA moves private 16-KiB two-byte-element operand panels through a complete-pair ring with LDGSTS.E.BYPASS.128 / LDGDEPBAR / DEPBAR, replicating the launch geometry and ring structure of the sm80 128-thread K64 staged GEMM source class without any matrix instruction, output epilogue, production shape, or production duration. Rounds 0 gives the same-grid empty launch plus ring prologue; the 256-to-512 steady-round secant gives the per-tier steady service; the finite residual follows the methodology of the accepted staged_ldgsts_depth3_wave_scaling_sm80 reference.

derived_model.finite_residual_definition: median duration at 32 rounds minus the same-grid zero-round launch and the 256-to-512 steady-round secant
derived_model.selection_rule: The staged GEMM operand stream is intrinsically mixed-tier: the shared A panel is L2-resident while each CTA's B panel strip is DRAM-unique. The parameter is the finite residual at one full launch-local cohort (108 CTAs = one resident CTA on each of 108 SMs), the midpoint mixed tier (50 pct L2), and the canonical three-complete-slot ring: 5120 ns.
derived_model.boundedness: The same-cell residual is 5120 ns at one wave, 5120 ns at two waves, and 7680 ns at 2.81 waves, so the launch-local fill is bounded rather than proportional to CTA-wave count, matching the accepted wave-scaling conclusion that later waves overlap the source finite fill with resident loop progress. A deeper five-slot ring does not increase the residual. Pure-DRAM streams (0 pct L2) show no positive residual at any grid, so the term attaches only when the operand stream carries both L2-hit and DRAM-miss bytes.
derived_model.formula: prediction = common_terms + one_wave_mixed_tier_startup_ns, once per launch

allowed_use: One launch-local additive startup for a staged K64-tile 128-thread two-byte-element GEMM source program whose operand read stream carries both L2-hit and DRAM-miss bytes, composed once per launch. The probe is byte-level, so the two-byte scope covers fp16 and bf16 element encodings of the same panel geometry.
forbidden_use: A production GEMM duration, a per-shape or per-bucket correction, a generic DRAM or L2 capacity replacement, a per-grid or per-wave latency lookup, or a second serial charge of work already inside the common K-tile pipeline. Pure-DRAM operand streams are outside scope (no positive residual measured).
